param: β Transmission rate parameter, representing the rate at which new infections take place given a contact. Inferred in the paper via re-parametrization, so no fixed value is provided.
σ Daily rate of transition through each of the two exposed (E) sub-compartments. The total average incubation period is 2/σ. Value is from Table 1.
γ Daily rate of transition through each of the two infectious (I) sub-compartments. This represents progression towards recovery. The total average infectious period is 2/γ. Value is from Table 1.
N Total population size. The paper provides values for three seasons; this value is for the 2012/13 season from Table 1.
